summary: Summer update from Christians Concerned for the Community: we’re delivering gently used furniture through our Home Delivery program and building accessibility ramps for neighbors in need — Grace at Fort Clarke completed three big projects in one Day of Action. McFall Builders even donated a new roof and new doors for our “Med Shed,” and volunteers are still needed for home projects and deliveries — click to read the full May newsletter and see photos.

Spring update from Christians Concerned for the Community — read how we’re remembering John Perkins’ legacy and celebrating volunteers like Will (Home Delivery) and the Alpha Omega group at CampusView Church who tackled a major yard cleanup. See recent ramp builds and home deliveries, find urgent needs (queen mattresses, pots & pans), and learn easy ways to give or volunteer — click to read Michael Lynch’s full Director’s Letter and get involved.

Read our Annual Report for 2025 to see the work that CCC has accomplished this past year! We are so thankful for all of our partners who make what we do possible, tangibly serving our neighbors in need as in image of God's love.

A brief newsletter giving updates about the year end of CCC! And a belated Merry Christmas! We hope and pray that the light of Christ has warmed the end of the year for everyone as we look forward to this new year.
CCC is expanding operations after our new hire, and we need your support! We're looking for ~$20k more in donations to meet our goal for this year.

Expanded Staff, Engaging with the Church, and the Exile of the local Church. Please read and share about the work and the needs of CCC, as we love our neighbors, as we expand our staff to increase our impact, and as we seek to raise more funds to make all that happen!

Please read and share our newsletter where we detail upcoming changes in order to grow our programs and our ability to connect the Church to love our neighbors in need! We are adding a staff member and request more funding in order to increase how we can serve our neighbors.
Read our Summer Newsletter, detailing how God is working in the community through our partners and the local church.
Read about the work of CCC the last couple months! And if you can, please spread the word about what we do.
